name: Wix
tagline: Website builder with templates, AI tools, ecommerce, bookings, and apps

pricing.notes: Official plan URL checked; 2026 public coverage lists Core around $29/month annual-effective, with monthly pricing/promos varying.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.limits: Up to 999 free sites; each site has 500 MB storage and 1 GB bandwidth on a wixsite.com URL, with Wix branding; no custom domain or online payments
tiers.notes: Free sites are indefinite and include hosting, templates, CMS and basic business tools.

tiers.name: Light
tiers.limits: 1 site; 2 GB storage; 2 site collaborators; custom domain and Wix-branding removal; no payment acceptance
tiers.notes: Per-site subscription. The annual plan is prepaid; a domain voucher is included for the first year.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.limits: 1 site; 50 GB storage; 5 collaborators; payments, basic ecommerce, scheduling and basic marketing suite

tiers.name: Business
tiers.limits: 1 site; 100 GB storage; 10 collaborators; standard ecommerce, scheduling and marketing suite

tiers.name: Business Elite
tiers.limits: 1 site; unlimited storage; 100 collaborators; advanced ecommerce, marketing, scheduling and developer-platform features

pricing.freeTierCaps: Up to 999 free sites; 500 MB storage and 1 GB bandwidth per site; wixsite.com URL and Wix branding; no custom domain or online payments
pricing.billingTerms: free + monthly, annual and longer paid terms; annual prices are monthly equivalents charged upfront; 14-day money-back guarantee
pricing.hiddenCosts: Each paid plan covers 1 site; domain renewal after the first-year voucher, business email, email-marketing allowances and many App Market products cost extra; payment processing, cross-border, currency-conversion, refund and chargeback fees apply by country; taxes are extra

verdictSummary: A custom site is buildable; Wix as a platform includes editor, templates, apps, ecommerce/bookings, hosting, domains, and a huge long-tail feature surface.
coreLoopDIY: Build the specific site directly with a framework or static generator and deploy it with forms/bookings/payments as needed.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because one website project tends to become ten maintenance requests.

priorArt.name: GrapesJS
priorArt.desc: Open-source web builder library for visual page editing.

alternatives.name: Microweber
alternatives.desc: Drag-and-drop websites and ecommerce with a real installer; the app market is smaller and the server is yours.

facts.install: Hosted signup, or upload the PHP package to a web host and complete its browser installer
facts.dataFormat: Site content and settings in a supported SQL database; images and other uploads in server storage
facts.gapVsPaid: Microweber has a much smaller app and template ecosystem and none of Wix's managed AI-and-operations convenience.
facts.setupBlocker: Self-hosting needs compatible PHP extensions, URL rewriting, a database and correct filesystem permissions

alternatives.name: Odoo Community
alternatives.desc: Website, ecommerce, CRM and business apps in one free suite; bookings and AI polish are less straightforward.

facts.install: Use Odoo's packaged installer, source install or Docker image, backed by PostgreSQL
facts.dataFormat: Business and website records in PostgreSQL; uploaded attachments in Odoo's filestore
facts.gapVsPaid: Odoo's website builder, templates, bookings and AI assistance are less polished and approachable than Wix's, while the suite is far more complex.
facts.setupBlocker: A production deployment needs PostgreSQL, workers/reverse proxy configuration, backups and ongoing administration of a very large suite

alternatives.name: Square Online
alternatives.desc: A hosted site, unlimited-product store and solo booking system free; design freedom and country coverage are narrower.

facts.install: Create a Square account and website from Square Dashboard
facts.dataFormat: Catalog, site content, customers, orders and payments in Square's managed cloud
facts.gapVsPaid: Square Online offers much narrower design freedom and app coverage than Wix and locks checkout and availability to Square's supported markets.
facts.setupBlocker: A verified Square business account in a supported country is required, and checkout remains tied to Square

alternatives.name: Vvveb
alternatives.desc: A visual CMS, forms, blog, shop and extensions in one install; AI hand-holding and managed operations are gone.

facts.install: Download and upload the PHP release, open the site URL, and complete the browser installer
facts.dataFormat: Content, products, orders and settings in MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite or PostgreSQL; media and downloadable files on the server filesystem
facts.gapVsPaid: Vvveb has a far smaller extension/template ecosystem and no Wix-style managed AI, bookings or operational hand-holding.
facts.setupBlocker: PHP hosting, a database, writable files, mail and payment configuration, plus ongoing server updates

alternatives.name: WordPress
alternatives.desc: The universal site platform with themes, plugins and an editor; bookings and commerce mean choosing more plugins.

facts.install: Use a host's one-click installer or upload WordPress and connect it to MySQL/MariaDB
facts.dataFormat: Posts, users, settings and metadata in SQL; themes, plugins and media in wp-content on the server filesystem
facts.gapVsPaid: WordPress does not bundle Wix's managed AI, app marketplace, bookings, commerce and support; reproducing them means choosing and maintaining plugins.
facts.setupBlocker: The reader must choose hosting, domain, theme and plugins, then own security, backups and updates

rejectedAlternatives.name: GrapesJS
rejectedAlternatives.desc: A library used to build visual editors, not a Wix replacement a normal person can sign up for.

notes: Good to compare with Webflow/Framer and show the DIY site-vs-builder distinction.
prompt:
Build me a website for my business to replace Wix · the one site I need, not a site builder. Requirements:

- An Astro static site: home, services, about, contact. Copy lives in Markdown and
  YAML data files so text edits never touch layout code.
- One mobile-first stylesheet with CSS custom properties for brand colors and type.
  No CSS framework, no page-builder abstraction.
- Contact form POSTs to a small Express handler: emails me via SMTP creds in .env
  and appends to data/messages.jsonl. Honeypot for spam.
- SEO basics at build time: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, per-page title/meta/OG tags,
  and a JSON-LD LocalBusiness block with hours and address.
- npm run build then rsync dist/ to my VPS, served by Caddy with automatic HTTPS.
- No accounts, no telemetry, no admin panel; content edits are git commits.
- If I need appointment booking, link to my scheduling tool; do not build a booking
  engine into this site.
- Out of scope: drag-and-drop editing, the app marketplace, and ecommerce. If the
  business needs a real store, that is a Shopify problem, not this build.
- README: DNS records, Caddy snippet, and exactly which files to edit for common
  copy changes.
